## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
load("../Pb_all.rda")
Pb_myregion <- filter(Pb_all, region == "Vasternorrland")
```

## Exploratory summary

```{r}
summary(Pb_myregion)
```

## Exponential model

```{r}
#| label: fig-exp
#| fig-cap: "Pb vs year with exponential fit."

m_exp <- lm(log(Pb) ~ year, data = Pb_myregion)
summary(m_exp)
```

## Linear model (centred at 1975)

```{r}
m_lin <- lm(Pb ~ I(year - 1975), data = Pb_myregion)
summary(m_lin)
confint(m_lin)
```

## Prediction for 2004

```{r}
predict(m_lin, newdata = data.frame(year = 2004), interval = "confidence")
```
